points.title: 早年教育
points.description: 大卫·休谟于1711年4月26日出生于爱丁堡的一个富裕家庭，是家中第二个儿子。他从小接受了良好的教育，最初在爱丁堡大学学习法律，但很快发现自己对哲学更感兴趣。在此期间，他广泛阅读古典文学和哲学著作，尤其是洛克和克拉克的作品。这段时期的学习为他后来的哲学思想奠定了基础，也培养了他对怀疑论的早期兴趣。休谟的早期教育经历塑造了他理性分析的能力，同时也埋下了他对传统宗教和形而上学质疑的种子。
points.descriptionEn: David Hume was born on April 26, 1711, in Edinburgh to a wealthy family, the second son of Joseph Hume and his wife Katherine. He received an excellent education, initially studying law at the University of Edinburgh, but soon discovered his greater interest in philosophy. During this period, he extensively read classical literature and philosophical works, particularly those of Locke and Clarke. This early education laid the foundation for his later philosophical ideas and cultivated his early interest in skepticism. Hume's formative education shaped his ability for rational analysis while also planting the seeds of his later questioning of traditional religion and metaphysics.

points.title: 哲学思想萌芽
points.description: 在爱丁堡大学期间，休谟开始发展自己的哲学体系。他经历了深刻的哲学危机，怀疑自己是否能够建立一门'道德与政治科学'。1734年，他完成了《人性论》的初稿，这是他最重要的哲学著作之一。这部作品后来成为经验主义哲学的里程碑。休谟在这一时期开始形成他的核心哲学观点，包括对因果关系的质疑、对自我概念的批判以及对理性在道德判断中作用的重新评估。这些思想在当时引起了巨大争议，但也奠定了他在哲学史上的重要地位。
points.descriptionEn: During his time at the University of Edinburgh, Hume began developing his philosophical system. He experienced a profound philosophical crisis, doubting whether he could establish a 'science of man' concerning moral and political matters. By 1734, he had completed the first draft of his 'A Treatise of Human Nature,' one of his most important philosophical works. This later became a landmark in empiricist philosophy. During this period, Hume began forming his core philosophical ideas, including his skepticism about causation, his critique of the concept of self, and his reassessment of reason's role in moral judgments. These ideas caused significant controversy at the time but established his important place in the history of philosophy.

points.title: 法国深造
points.description: 1734年，休谟前往法国拉弗莱什的耶稣会学院深造。这个地方是笛卡尔曾经学习的地方，对休谟的思想产生了深远影响。在这里，他完成了《人性论》的大部分内容，并开始发展他的怀疑主义哲学。法国的学术环境使休谟能够更自由地探索激进的思想，不受英国学术界的限制。他在这一时期形成了对人类心理和行为的系统分析，提出了著名的'印象'和'观念'理论。这段经历极大地丰富了他的哲学思想，也为他后来的学术生涯奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: In 1734, Hume traveled to La Flèche, France, to study at the Jesuit College where Descartes had once studied. This place profoundly influenced Hume's thinking. Here, he completed most of 'A Treatise of Human Nature' and began developing his skeptical philosophy. The French academic environment allowed Hume to explore radical ideas more freely, without the constraints of British academia. During this period, he formed his systematic analysis of human psychology and behavior, proposing his famous theory of 'impressions' and 'ideas.' This experience greatly enriched his philosophical thought and laid the foundation for his later academic career.

points.title: 学术发展与著作出版
points.description: 1739年，休谟返回爱丁堡，并开始出版《人性论》。这部作品虽然在当时引起了争议，但确立了他在哲学界的地位。1741-1742年，他出版了《道德和政治论文集》，获得了广泛认可。1748年，他出版了《人类理解研究》，这是《人性论》的简化版本，更容易被大众接受。1751年，他出版了《道德原则研究》，进一步发展了他的伦理学理论。在此期间，休谟还担任过各种职务，包括家庭教师和图书馆管理员。1752年，他被任命为爱丁堡大学图书馆馆长，这一职位使他能够接触到大量学术资源，促进了他的学术发展。
points.descriptionEn: Returning to Edinburgh in 1739, Hume began publishing 'A Treatise of Human Nature.' Although controversial at the time, this work established his position in philosophical circles. From 1741-1742, he published 'Essays, Moral and Political,' which gained wide recognition. In 1748, he published 'An Enquiry Concerning Human Understanding,' a simplified version of the 'Treatise' that was more accessible to the general public. In 1751, he published 'An Enquiry Concerning the Principles of Morals,' further developing his ethical theories. During this period, Hume held various positions, including tutor and librarian. In 1752, he was appointed Keeper of the Advocates' Library in Edinburgh, a position that gave him access to extensive academic resources and facilitated his scholarly development.

points.title: 晚年外交与哲学完善
points.description: 1763年，休谟作为英国驻法国大使馆的秘书前往巴黎，在那里度过了三年时间。他在法国社交界获得了巨大成功，与伏尔泰、卢梭等启蒙思想家建立了联系。1766年，他短暂返回英国，后于1767-1768年担任英国驻巴黎大使馆的代理大使。1769年，休谟回到爱丁堡，度过了他的晚年。在这一时期，他继续完善他的哲学思想，并撰写了《自然宗教对话录》等重要作品。1776年，休谟在爱丁堡逝世，享年65岁。他的晚年虽然健康状况不佳，但思想依然活跃，对后世哲学产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: In 1763, Hume traveled to Paris as secretary to the British embassy, where he spent three years. He achieved great success in French social circles, establishing connections with Enlightenment thinkers such as Voltaire and Rousseau. In 1766, he briefly returned to England, then served as British chargé d'affaires in Paris from 1767-1768. In 1769, Hume returned to Edinburgh, where he spent his final years. During this period, he continued to refine his philosophical ideas and wrote important works such as 'Dialogues Concerning Natural Religion.' In 1776, Hume died in Edinburgh at the age of 65. Despite declining health in his later years, his mind remained active, exerting profound influence on subsequent philosophy.

appraisal.zh: 休谟被公认为苏格兰启蒙运动的核心人物和经验主义哲学的奠基人之一，他对因果关系的分析至今仍是科学哲学的核心议题，其“应然”与“实然”的区分深刻影响了伦理学与政治哲学，怀疑精神也为现代世俗社会提供了思想基础。也有研究者指出，彻底的怀疑主义可能滑向相对主义，基于习惯的因果观被指动摇科学规律的可靠性，道德情感主义则显得过于主观。这些局限使他的思想在某些方面显得不够彻底。
appraisal.en: Hume is widely recognized as a central figure of the Scottish Enlightenment and a founder of empiricist philosophy; his analysis of causation remains a core topic in the philosophy of science, his distinction between is and ought has deeply influenced ethics and political philosophy, and his skepticism provided an intellectual foundation for modern secular society. Yet some researchers point out that thorough skepticism may slide into relativism, that a habit-based account of causation is said to undermine the reliability of scientific laws, and that moral sentimentalism appears too subjective. These limitations leave his thought incomplete in certain respects.

supporter.zh: 休谟被视为经验主义哲学的奠基人之一，他的怀疑论思想为现代科学方法论奠定了基础。支持者认为休谟通过批判传统形而上学，开辟了哲学研究的新路径。他的道德情感主义理论挑战了理性主义的道德观，强调了情感在道德判断中的核心作用。休谟对因果关系的分析至今仍是科学哲学讨论的核心议题，他的'应然'与'实然'区分原则对伦理学和政治哲学产生了深远影响。作为启蒙运动的重要思想家，休谟的理性怀疑精神为现代世俗社会的发展提供了思想基础。
supporter.en: Hume is regarded as one of the founders of empiricist philosophy, and his skeptical thought laid the foundation for modern scientific methodology. Supporters argue that by critiquing traditional metaphysics, Hume开辟了 a new path for philosophical inquiry. His moral sentimentalism challenged rationalist moral theories by emphasizing the central role of emotions in moral judgment. Hume's analysis of causation remains a central topic in the philosophy of science, and his distinction between 'is' and 'ought' has profoundly influenced ethics and political philosophy. As an important Enlightenment thinker, Hume's spirit of rational skepticism provided the intellectual foundation for the development of modern secular society.

critic.zh: 批评者认为休谟的彻底怀疑主义导致了相对主义和虚无主义，削弱了客观真理的可能性。他的因果关系理论被指责为破坏了科学的基础，因为如果因果关系仅基于习惯而非客观联系，科学规律的可靠性将受到质疑。此外，休谟的道德情感主义被认为过于主观，无法提供普遍的道德标准。批评者还指出，休谟虽然批判宗教，却未能完全摆脱宗教思维的影响，他的自然宗教观点仍然保留了某种形式的神学框架。这些局限性使休谟的思想在某些方面被认为是不彻底或自相矛盾的。
critic.en: Critics argue that Hume's thorough skepticism leads to relativism and nihilism, undermining the possibility of objective truth. His theory of causation has been accused of undermining the foundations of science, as if causal relations are based merely on habit rather than objective connections, the reliability of scientific laws becomes questionable. Additionally, Hume's moral sentimentalism is considered too subjective to provide universal moral standards. Critics also note that while Hume critiqued religion, he未能完全摆脱 religious thinking, and his views on natural religion still retained some form of theological framework. These limitations make Hume's thought appear incomplete or self-contradictory in certain aspects.

objective.zh: 在历史学界，休谟被公认为苏格兰启蒙运动的核心人物，他的思想对后世哲学、心理学和政治学产生了深远影响。流行文化中，休谟常被描绘为理性怀疑主义的象征，代表了启蒙运动对传统权威的挑战。他的名言'理性是且只应该是激情的奴隶'已成为现代思想史上的经典表述。休谟的思想既影响了康德等后辈哲学家，也为现代实证主义和分析哲学奠定了基础。在当代学术界，休谟的著作被广泛研究，他的怀疑论方法仍在科学哲学、认识论和伦理学等领域引发持续讨论，使他成为西方哲学史上最具影响力的思想家之一。
objective.en: In historical scholarship, Hume is widely recognized as a central figure of the Scottish Enlightenment, whose ideas profoundly influenced subsequent philosophy, psychology, and political science. In popular culture, Hume is often depicted as a symbol of rational skepticism, representing the Enlightenment's challenge to traditional authority. His famous quote 'Reason is, and ought only to be the slave of the passions' has become a classic expression in the history of modern thought. Hume's ideas influenced later philosophers such as Kant and laid the foundation for modern positivism and analytic philosophy. In contemporary academia, Hume's works are extensively studied, and his skeptical methods continue to provoke ongoing discussion in fields such as philosophy of science, epistemology, and ethics, making him one of the most influential thinkers in the history of Western philosophy.

self.zh: 理性是且只应该是激情的奴隶，除了服务和服从激情之外，永远不能假装有任何其他职务。
self.en: Reason is, and ought only to be the slave of the passions, and can never pretend to any other office than to serve and obey them.
